Automakers build up inventory to meet festive season demand Maruti, Hyundai and Mahindra preparing to meet higher sales 2 lakh pending bookings ahead of the festive season, while Hyundai Motor India has built four-five weeks of inventory across its dealer network Tarun Garg, MD & CEO, Hyundai Motor India Ltd, said, "The festive season continues to be a key growth driver for the Indian automotive industry, and we have been proactively preparing our operations, dealer network and supply chain to effectively cater to customer demand across the country " "Over the past few months, we have strengthened dealer inventory, optimised logistics and enhanced product availability across the Hyundai Motor India Limited network to support timely deliveries and a seamless customer experience," he added Garg shared that Hyundai Motor India Ltd has proactively built dealer inventory ahead of the festive season, with inventory levels of 4-5 weeks across its network, to effectively cater to anticipated festive demand. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

matched_articles.title: Nexon Geochem inks MoU for rare earth permanent magnet facility in Andhra Pradesh
matched_articles.summary: Nexon 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Nexon Geochem inks MoU for rare earth permanent magnet facility in Andhra Pradesh'이다. Nexon Geochem has committed a total investment of ₹1,250 crore across two phases: ₹750 crore dedicated to Phase 1 and ₹500 crore allocated for Phase 2. As the primary investor behind the project, Nexon Geochem has committed a total investment of ₹1,250 crore across two phases: ₹750 crore dedicated to Phase 1 and ₹500 crore allocated for Phase 2 The phased investment outlay, alongside Nexon’s specialised technology, design engineering, and advanced equipment will back a world-class manufacturing ecosystem across a 30-acre footprint Praveen Kumar Choudhary, Director of Nexon Geochem, told businessline , “Our vision is to establish an integrated NdFeB magnet manufacturing ecosystem that strengthens supply-chain security, reduces import dependence, and supports India’s ambitions in electric mobility, renewable energy, and advanced manufacturing Nexon Geochem will work closely with relevant state departments to progress land allotment and infrastructure development in a strictly time-bound manner Through this multi-phase development roadmap, Nexon Geochem is well-positioned to scale domestic manufacturing capacity swiftly, delivering long-term strategic value to both the state of Andhra Pradesh and India’s broader green economy. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

The Trump administration is pressing SK Hynix, Samsung and other foreign chipmakers to build plants in the US in a drive to rebuild US manufacturing capacity and create jobs. "The installation of equipment for Mod B is being carried out in close consultation with and under authorization from the US government," SK Hynix said in a statement to Reuters In December, the department issued a 2026 license for SK Hynix's Dalian site that limited the quantity of equipment SK Hynix's Dalian facility is home to a fab space known as Mod B that it built in 2023, one source said Reuters reported last month that SK Hynix was separately in talks with Intel to lease part of its long-planned chipmaking facility in Ohio SK Hynix's Seoul-listed shares slumped 11% amid a broader tech selloff on Thursday. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
